params.name: BULK_FRACTION
params.why: track0_harness.py:32; central window by ROOT INDEX

params.name: phi
params.why: BRIEF: planted phase 0.3; any fixed generic phase serves

params.name: hann_taper
params.why: BRIEF: Hann taper on the projection; suppresses window-edge leakage
params.value: w_j = sin^2(pi (j+1/2)/W) over the W bulk indices

params.name: index_shift
params.why: BRIEF: each derivative moves the root set by half an index
params.value: root i of p^(k) sits at seed index i + k/2

params.name: local_spacing
params.why: BRIEF: convert displacements to local spacings using the LATTICE run's gaps
params.value: h_i = (x_{i+1} - x_{i-1})/2 of the LATTICE run (one-sided at ends)

params.name: gain_estimator
params.why: complex projection so a phase drift counts as error, not as a smaller real gain
params.value: gain_c = i * 2 * sum_j w_j y_j exp(-i theta_j) / (A * sum_j w_j); rel_err = |gain_c - gain_pred| / gain_pred

params.name: FLOAT64_FLOOR_ULPS
params.why: assessability: a cell is FLOAT64-ASSESSABLE iff A*gain_pred >= (1/FLOAT64_RELERR_TARGET) * FLOAT64_FLOOR_ULPS * eps_mach * max|x| / h_bulk. Below that the 1e-3 bar is not testable in float64 (the int128 arm the BRIEF intended does not exist in the repo); such cells are INAPPLICABLE-FLOAT64, never PASS and never FAIL. The empirical residual RMS is reported per cell so the declared floor is checked against the measured one

params.name: solver
params.why: same algorithm and precision; GPU makes n=16384 feasible. Contingency if NOT certified: ML n=16384 restricted to A in {1e-5, 1e-3} and MT flows on CPU (declared now, before the gate result is known)
params.value: modes_common.diff_step_gpu IF gpu_solver_gate.json reads GPU_SOLVER_CERTIFIED, else track0_harness.diff_step

params.name: mt_unfolded_positions
params.why: BRIEF: if only gaps were exposed, cumulative sums would be declared; not needed
params.value: F_at * m from reference_cdf (production exposes positions)

params.name: mt_B_kernel
params.why: BRIEF: B is the arm's smoothing transfer at qw from the kernel recorded in M0.5 (Poisson/Cauchy kernel has Fourier transform exp(-|q| eps))
params.value: Poisson kernel at height eps: B = exp(-qw * eps_sp), eps_sp = eps_k/Delta_s = sqrt(0.25+16(n-k)/(kn)); PROD_BW1 eps_sp, PROD_BW2 2*eps_sp; B = 1 on PROD_PRIMARY (Richardson)

params.name: m6_bound
params.why: MANIFEST_M0 M6_bound_conflict: the looser bound cannot fire on its own red path

params.name: p_tail_range
params.value: k in [16, k_grid_max]; report-only if k_grid_max < 48

params.name: bootstrap_resamples
params.why: replicate bootstrap for the second error model

params.name: qlattice_semicircle_sigma
params.why: read from the production GUE_DE normalisation (KS-minimising sigma = 1.00, MANIFEST_M0 M0.5)

ML.seeds: LATTICE and LATTICE_WAVE(qw, A, phi=0.3), n in {4096, 16384}
ML.int128_arm: HELD — no int128 path exists (MANIFEST_M0 M0.6); A in {1e-9, 1e-7} run as float64 twins only
ML.pass_rule: PASS iff rel_err <= 1e-3 in EVERY cell with A <= 1e-5, qw >= 0.1, (1-qw/pi)^k >= 1e-8 that is FLOAT64-ASSESSABLE (declared rule above); cells that are not assessable are listed, counted, and the gate's coverage is stated. qw < 0.1 report-only (finite-n corrections ~ k/(qw n))
ML.grade: SEALED for A >= 1e-5 float64 cells (unseen); the (1 - qw/pi) law itself is DECLARED-WITH-PRIOR-LOOK
ML.nonlinear_onset: report the smallest A with rel_err > 1e-2, per (n, qw, k)
ML.red_path: solver with sign(x-r_j)|x-r_j|^-1.2 (exists only inside the checker) must FAIL the gate

known_answers.LATTICE_omr: NOUNFOLD omr(LATTICE, k=0) <= 1e-12 at n in {4096, 16384}
known_answers.LATTICE_WAVE_omr: A=1e-4, qw in {1.0, 2.0}: NOUNFOLD omr at k=0 within 1% of (8A/pi) sin^2(qw/2)
known_answers.QLATTICE_semicircle: t_flow in {0, 64/n}, n in {4096, 16384}: NOUNFOLD omr reported (density-gradient floor ~1/n); POPREF omr <= 1e-10 (BRIEF bar). The repo's own Gate L bar for the same class of check is 1e-7; if 1e-10 fails and 1e-7 holds, that is reported as a BRIEF-vs-instrument conflict, not silently regraded

ML.existing_gates_rerun: track0_harness (Hermite self-map), reference_v2_gates (lattice + Hermite-through-reference), verify_knownanswer (Gate D) — executed in a scratch cwd so no frozen artifact is rewritten; verdicts and worst numbers recorded; any FAIL stops the night

MT.seeds: LATTICE_WAVE(qw, A=1e-5, phi=0.3) and LATTICE at n=16384
MT.definition: T = P_c(u_wave - u_lattice) / P_c((x_wave - x_lattice)/h_local), complex projections on exp(-i theta), theta = qw (i + k/2) + phi, Hann-tapered bulk window; each run unfolded against ITS OWN reference (F_empirical of its own seed) exactly as production
MT.prod_prediction: T_pred = 1 - B exp(k [-ln(1 - qw/pi) - qw/pi]), B per arm as declared (mt_B_kernel)
MT.pass_rule: PASS iff |T - T_pred| <= 0.1 for every PROD arm at 0.1 <= qw <= 0.5, every k in K_MT; other qw report-only
MT.grade: SEALED (no MT number has been seen)

M3.cells: IID_UNIFORM and GUE_DE x n in {1024, 2048, 4096} x sealed 16 replicates x K_DENSE, identical roots per cell; n=16384 NOT RUN tonight (MANIFEST_M0 cuts)
M3.banked_per_cell: per-replicate omr at every k; k* by (a) production F3 ladder + kstar() and (b) monotone log-linear interpolation; p_tail over [16, 64]; both error models

predictions.P_M3_1: comparator k* > PROD_PRIMARY k* in every (class, n) cell

predictions.P_M3_2: NOUNFOLD k*_fit for IID_UNIFORM in [20, 32] at every n

predictions.P_M3_3: NOUNFOLD p_tail for IID_UNIFORM in [1.35, 1.65] at every n

M3.lineage: arms within a cell share roots -> non-independent along 'data' (lineage.Lineage recorded per cell)
M3.f3_ladder_on_comparators: run, labelled NEW OBJECT (no seal covers its form on these arms)

M6.check: D_k <= k/n at every banked k of every flow (sharp Rolle bound); report max D_k n/k and max D_k (n-k)/(2k) per class
M6.red_path: one root moved one bracket outward must fire (checker)

branch_rules.1: ML fails, or M0.10 fails to reproduce -> STOP
branch_rules.2: smoke cell: |k*(NOUNFOLD) - k*(PROD_PRIMARY)| <= 3 sigma_eff AND |p_tail difference| <= 0.15 -> reference hypothesis DEAD, DROPPED ledger row, Night 2 cancelled (sigma_eff = sqrt(err_cov(NOUNFOLD)^2 + err_cov(PROD)^2))
branch_rules.3: else if MT passes -> recommend Night 2 (needs Will's go)
branch_rules.4: else -> recommend a full MT characterisation night

token_rules.GATE_ML: per ML pass_rule on float64-assessable cells; coverage stated
token_rules.REFERENCE: REFERENCE_IS_MACROSCOPIC iff MT PASS and |T_pred - 1| <= 0.1 on all PROD arms at 0.1<=qw<=0.5 for k<=40 (i.e. the reference neither absorbs nor injects at the planted scale); else REFERENCE_ABSORBS_AND_INJECTS
token_rules.NOUNFOLD: NOUNFOLD_EXCEEDS_PRODUCTION iff branch rule 2 does NOT fire on the smoke cell AND P_M3_1 holds in every run cell
token_rules.INTERLACING: INTERLACING_BOUND_HOLDS iff no flow ever exceeds k/n
